name: Bosch's Blueberry Hill Farm
description: In Woodland, WA, Bosch's Blueberry Hill Farm raises Blueberries on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
